applications.title: Published Mitsui to Gaussian and rational all-endpoint sums
applications.status: Fresh published bytes/conventions checked; historical exact hash matched; full PP acceptance not asserted

obligations.name: source_hypotheses
obligations.required: Fixed number field, fixed logarithmic exponent, ray character modulus norm bound.
obligations.constructed: E=Q(i), fixed χ modulo m; variable ρ modulo q<=(logX)^B.
obligations.why_match: θ=χ(ρ∘Norm) has modulus dividing m(q), norm<=Nm q².

obligations.name: constructed_objects
obligations.required: Actual Hecke character and ideal von Mangoldt sum.
obligations.constructed: θ(a)=χ(a)ρ(Na), ΛE(p^j)=logNp, zero elsewhere.
obligations.why_match: The pointwise character identity gives the exact summand in the application.

obligations.name: domain_index_coverage
obligations.required: Uniform over all X>=3,1<=Y<=X,q and ρ.
obligations.constructed: For Y>=√X use exponent2B+1; for smallerY elementary bound; boundedX absorbed.
obligations.why_match: No application at Y violates the modulus bound. The field/ray modulus remain fixed.

obligations.name: transition_comparison_maps
obligations.required: Prime-ideal to prime-power sum and primitive/imprimitive restoration.
obligations.constructed: Complex-valued unsmoothing and O(√Ylog²Y) prime-power error; optional excluded Euler-factor error.
obligations.why_match: Absolute values control boundary terms without positivity; conductor restoration changes no main term.

obligations.name: identity_of_consumed_object
obligations.required: Principal main term for the actual twisted character.
obligations.constructed: r=1 iff the inducing primitive Hecke character is trivial.
obligations.why_match: This is exactly Mitsui E(θ), even though imprimitive zero extension is not1 on excluded ideals.

obligations.name: coefficients_normalizations
obligations.required: Error normalized by X and rational analog.
obligations.constructed: Xexp(−c√logX), χ,B fixed; K=Q uses B+1 and the real infinite place if needed.
obligations.why_match: The same source covers Q; no n>=2 restriction appears on inspectedp2.

obligations.name: local_conditions
obligations.required: All residue degrees and excluded primes.
obligations.constructed: All prime ideals included; character extended by zero at noncoprime ideals.
obligations.why_match: Degree-one rational prime conversion occurs later with its factor2; not silently at this source application.

obligations.name: exceptional_cases
obligations.required: Small endpoints, imprimitive characters, exceptional zeros.
obligations.constructed: Small endpoints trivial; principal definition checked; constants ineffective.
obligations.why_match: No effective or varying-field claim added; Mitsui theorem is used directly, not an unverified correction to Kane.

obligations.name: downstream_consumption
obligations.required: Finite ray-character expansion in the actual Gaussian centered weight.
obligations.constructed: Supplies the strong SW estimate used by fixed-modulus progressions and factorization.
obligations.why_match: It is a prime-sum input only, not itself the nilsequence or polynomial-pattern theorem.
